contract: docs/PRE_REGISTRATION.md + amendments A2-A7; harness/g05_gate.sh is the arbiter

index.derived_rule: derived.* rows are arithmetic on the cited leaves, computed by src/receipt_index.py
index.gate_rule: gate.* rows are the counts src/gate_receipt.py parsed from the four harness logs; the receipt also pins the log digests, so one run is traceable to the byte text behind those counts
index.rows_rule: one row per numeric leaf of a source receipt; a numeric-only list contributes .len/.max/.min only; string leaves count only when the whole string is a number
index.value_rule: repr of the leaf, unrounded; no wall-clock field, so the file is byte-identical across regenerations
